analysis: The change is documentation-only in docs/architecture/hardware-support.md. It bumps the date (line 3) and adds a head-side section at lines 371-408 describing selected-model recovery in ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift. That section covers the retry schedule, the loads with allowEviction:false, and victim eviction rules. The rules are: evict only resident models with no evictionExclusions entry, skip anything isProtectedFromRecoveryEviction keeps, and require dwell, lease and idle checks. The text does not touch the Secure Enclave or X25519 keys, attestation, wire protocol, encryption, the prefix cache (T-041) or the fan helper. Because this is docs only, no controls are modified by this diff. The nearest threat surface is A-018 and T-016 (availability): recovery may unload idle resident models, and it excludes pinned, held and in-flight models. This is a described local policy that stays inside the unchanged load gate, pending-load claims and eviction. I examined base lines 453-843 (unchanged by the patch) and head lines 1-445. The cap, reserve, load-gate and Super claim math that the new section references is unchanged. The implementation source is not supplied, so the behavior is unverified. The only remaining question is whether the Swift code matches the documented guards, such as the exclusions and per-model victim rules. That question cannot be answered from this diff and does not rise to a finding.
